Base directory for this skill: /Users/a39326/.claude/skills/seo-audit

# Full Website SEO Audit

## Process

1. **Fetch homepage** — use `scripts/fetch_page.py` to retrieve HTML
2. **Detect business type** — analyze homepage signals per seo orchestrator
3. **Crawl site** — follow internal links up to 500 pages, respect robots.txt
4. **Delegate to subagents** (if available, otherwise run inline sequentially):
   - `seo-technical` — robots.txt, sitemaps, canonicals, Core Web Vitals, security headers
   - `seo-content` — E-E-A-T, readability, thin content, AI citation readiness
   - `seo-schema` — detection, validation, generation recommendations
   - `seo-sitemap` — structure analysis, quality gates, missing pages
   - `seo-performance` — LCP, INP, CLS measurements
   - `seo-visual` — screenshots, mobile testing, above-fold analysis
5. **Score** — aggregate into SEO Health Score (0-100)
6. **Report** — generate prioritized action plan

## Crawl Configuration

```
Max pages: 500
Respect robots.txt: Yes
Follow redirects: Yes (max 3 hops)
Timeout per page: 30 seconds
Concurrent requests: 5
Delay between requests: 1 second
```

## Output Files

- `FULL-AUDIT-REPORT.md` — Comprehensive findings
- `ACTION-PLAN.md` — Prioritized recommendations (Critical → High → Medium → Low)
- `screenshots/` — Desktop + mobile captures (if Playwright available)

## Scoring Weights

| Category | Weight |
|----------|--------|
| Technical SEO | 25% |
| Content Quality | 25% |
| On-Page SEO | 20% |
| Schema / Structured Data | 10% |
| Performance (CWV) | 10% |
| Images | 5% |
| AI Search Readiness | 5% |

## Report Structure

### Executive Summary
- Overall SEO Health Score (0-100)
- Business type detected
- Top 5 critical issues
- Top 5 quick wins

### Technical SEO
- Crawlability issues
- Indexability problems
- Security concerns
- Core Web Vitals status

### Content Quality
- E-E-A-T assessment
- Thin content pages
- Duplicate content issues
- Readability scores

### On-Page SEO
- Title tag issues
- Meta description problems
- Heading structure
- Internal linking gaps

### Schema & Structured Data
- Current implementation
- Validation errors
- Missing opportunities

### Performance
- LCP, INP, CLS scores
- Resource optimization needs
- Third-party script impact

### Images
- Missing alt text
- Oversized images
- Format recommendations

### AI Search Readiness
- Citability score
- Structural improvements
- Authority signals

## Priority Definitions

- **Critical**: Blocks indexing or causes penalties (fix immediately)
- **High**: Significantly impacts rankings (fix within 1 week)
- **Medium**: Optimization opportunity (fix within 1 month)
- **Low**: Nice to have (backlog)

## DataForSEO Integration (Optional)

If DataForSEO MCP tools are available, spawn the `seo-dataforseo` agent alongside existing subagents to enrich the audit with live data: real SERP positions, backlink profiles with spam scores, on-page analysis (Lighthouse), business listings, and AI visibility checks (ChatGPT scraper, LLM mentions).

Boilerplate metadata — title is "Create Next App", description is "Generated by create next app" 2. Entire page is client-side rendered (`"use client"`) — search engines cannot index content 3. No `robots.txt` — the app is crawlable by default with no crawl direction 4. No security headers configured in `next.config.ts` — exposes to clickjacking, XSS, MIME sniffing 5. API routes (`/api/chat`, `/api/send-slack`) have zero authentication — open to abuse ### Top 5 Quick Wins 1. Fix title and description in `app/layout.tsx` (5-minute fix) 2. Add `robots.txt` to `public/` with `Disallow: /` to prevent indexing of internal tool (2-minute fix) 3. Add security headers to `next.config.ts` (15-minute fix) 4. Add Open Graph tags to `layout.tsx` (10-minute fix) 5. Delete unused default Next.js SVG assets from `public/` (2-minute fix) --- ## Technical SEO ### Crawlability | Check | Status | Detail | |---|---|---| | robots.txt | ❌ Missing | No `public/robots.txt` — crawlers will index everything by default | | sitemap.xml | ❌ Missing | No sitemap anywhere in the project | | Canonical tag | ❌ Missing | No `` in `layout.tsx` | | Internal links | N/A | Single-page app, no internal links | | 404 handling | ✅ Default | Next.js provides default 404 | | Redirect handling | N/A | No redirects configured | **Recommendation:** Since this is an internal tool, add `robots.txt` with `Disallow: /` to prevent accidental indexing. ```txt # /public/robots.txt User-agent: * Disallow: / ``` ### Indexability | Check | Status | Detail | |---|---|---| | `noindex` directives | ❌ None | No noindex meta tag preventing indexing | | Meta robots | ❌ Missing | Not set in `layout.tsx` | | `lang` attribute | ✅ Set | `` in layout | | Viewport meta | ✅ Auto | Next.js adds viewport automatically | ### Security | Check | Status | Detail | |---|---|---| | X-Frame-Options | ❌ Missing | Not set — clickjacking risk | | Content-Security-Policy | ❌ Missing | No CSP header | | X-Content-Type-Options | ❌ Missing | MIME sniffing vulnerability | | Strict-Transport-Security | ❌ Missing | HSTS not configured | | Referrer-Policy | ❌ Missing | Not set | | Permissions-Policy | ❌ Missing | Not set | | API authentication | ❌ Missing | `/api/chat` and `/api/send-slack` accept unauthenticated POST requests from any origin | **File:** `next.config.ts:1` — currently empty, no headers configured. Recommended headers block for `next.config.ts`: ```ts headers: async () => [ { source: '/(.*)', headers: [ { key: 'X-Frame-Options', value: 'DENY' }, { key: 'X-Content-Type-Options', value: 'nosniff' }, { key: 'Referrer-Policy', value: 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin' }, { key: 'Permissions-Policy', value: 'camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()' }, ], }, ], ``` ### URL Structure | Check | Status | Detail | |---|---|---| | Clean URLs | ✅ | `/`, `/api/chat`, `/api/send-slack` — clean | | Trailing slash consistency | ✅ | Consistent | | URL depth | ✅ | Shallow | ### Core Web Vitals (Estimated — no live server) | Metric | Estimate | Concern | |---|---|---| | LCP | ~1.5s | Low — minimal content, Geist font via `next/font` (auto-optimized) | | INP | ~50ms | Low — minimal interactivity | | CLS | ~0 | Very low — layout is static | **Positive:** `next/font` is used for Geist (Google Fonts variant), which eliminates render-blocking font requests and prevents layout shift. Tailwind CSS v4 generates minimal CSS. --- ## Content Quality ### E-E-A-T Assessment | Signal | Status | Detail | |---|---|---| | Experience | N/A | Internal tool, no public content | | Expertise | ❌ No signals | No author info, no about page | | Authoritativeness | ❌ No signals | No external links, citations | | Trustworthiness | ❌ No signals | No privacy policy, terms, or contact | ### Content Architecture | Check | Status | Detail | |---|---|---| | Content rendering | ❌ CSR Only | `"use client"` on `app/page.tsx:1` — entire UI is JS-rendered | | Static indexable content | ❌ None | No SSR or SSG pages with crawlable content | | Thin content | N/A | Internal tool | | Duplicate content | N/A | Single page | **Critical issue:** The entire page is client-side rendered. Search engines (and AI crawlers) receive an essentially empty HTML shell.
